svg.title: BDhighresDA pipeline
svg.text: learn the downscaler p( 5 km rainfall | ERA5 )
u_theta( x_t , t , c ) — velocity field, ~30 M params
Gauges and satellite rainfall are used nowhere in Phase 1.
The network only ever learns the map
So the observing network can change — new gauges, IMERG
V07 → V08, Early instead of Final, radar later — and
nothing needs retraining. That is the whole reason for
putting the background in the prior and the observations in
the likelihood, rather than feeding everything to the network.
PHASE 2 · INFERENCE — every day, no retraining
sample the prior, then assimilate observations while sampling
every step: dx = ( u_theta(x_t, t, c) + Delta_u_obs ) dt
Observations off → BACKGROUND (first guess, ERA5 alone)
Spread: x_0 draw × prior temperature T · perturbed y · optional future EDA
p(y | x_t) = N( y | H(x1), R + Gamma·(1−t)²/t² )
IMERG is quantile-mapped to CHIRPS first — a Gaussian
Each member assimilates its own draw y_r = y + eps_r
Verify at withheld gauges (3-fold CV): CRPS · RMSE / MAE ·
FSS · SAL · POD / FAR / CSI — and, because generative DA is
reliably under-dispersive, spread–skill by intensity plus
rank histograms with observation error added to members.
Baselines: ERA5 · IMERG · CHIRPS · kriging · deterministic U-Net
Target: −10% RMSE at left-out stations (Manshausen et al. 2025)
Tune Gamma, sigma_obs and the prior temperature T on pseudo-observations — CHIRPS sampled at the gauge sites, where the true field is known — before ever touching real gauges.
